findings.title: Gaza: Israel denies treatment and dignity to children left amputees by its genocide
findings.affected_population_or_system: Children with limb amputations; prosthetics, rehabilitation, specialist healthcare access and medical evacuation pathways
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Israel’s restrictions on patient travel and obstruction of medical evacuations further limit children’s access to specialised treatment unavailable inside the Gaza Strip.
findings.source_type: primary NGO field-report/rights-monitor assessment; Al Jazeera secondary reporting
findings.summary: In a November 4 assessment, Euro-Med Human Rights Monitor reported 1,134 children in Gaza had undergone amputations as of October 9, 2026 and described ongoing barriers to specialized treatment, rehabilitation and patient travel. Its report references previously published WHO data that 500 of 2,300 amputees assessed September 2024–May 2026 received permanent prosthetics. This is newly surfaced quantified documentation of continuing healthcare access disruption, NOT 1,134 new amputations, a newly imposed restriction, or a newly confirmed November 4 incident. Primary claims have not been independently verified by the watch.
